title: Adaptive Flow Preview
description: Replace ad-hoc single-string flow preview with content-adaptive rectangle: number/text sized to value, images as native Vello pixels, fallback interactive foldable JSON tree. Add image input widget.
summary: Replaced ad-hoc `format_dictionary_preview` string flattening with typed `DagPreviewContent` (scalar/image/tree) on `DagNodeKind::Preview`, content-driven node sizing, native Vello image painting via `icon_paint_cache`, and canvas-native recursive JSON tree with click-to-expand rows. Added `Widget::InputImage` / `DagNodeKind::Image`, `setImageSrc` WASM API, catalogue entry, and flow react double-click file picker. Preview fold state persists in `expanded` on widget and DAG node.
